name: local llama
author: mihai
description: Load and unload local llama.cpp model servers from the Omarchy bar. Seven presets are verified to emit real OpenAI tool calls and so work as opencode models (Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B/14B, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, Gemma 4 E2B, gpt-oss-20b); four more ship as chat-only launchers because they don't survive tool calling. Nothing occupies RAM or VRAM until you pick a model and click Load.

barWidget.description: Start/stop local llama.cpp servers and show which model is currently loaded for opencode.
